findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Upon arrival, inspector observed dishes to be washed in the front hand sink. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper dish washing and practice was stopped. Ensure hand sinks are solely being used for hand washing, and that dishes are put through the wash, rinse, and sanitize process.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: Observed Sammy eggs to be resting at 70F, eggs were prepared 2 hours before. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper cold holding/cooling and eggs were moved to cooler. Education was provided on possibly placing eggs under a TAC, however PIC decided on cold holding the eggs. Ensure any TCS item is being cold held at or below 41F
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed in use quiche to not have date marking available. Discussed with PIC, quiche was prepared within the last 7 days. Education on proper date marking was provided and date was placed on quiche. Ensure any TCS item kept longer than 24 hours has the required date marking available.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).
